test_seq2seq_collater_collate: test the Seq2SeqCollater collate method to batch speech recognition samples with padding and sorting
test_collate_sorting_by_length: test that Seq2SeqCollater sorts input samples by frame length before creating the batch
test_collate_padding: test that Seq2SeqCollater pads shorter feature sequences with the pad index value
test_collate_target_tokens: test that Seq2SeqCollater creates prev_output_tokens with eos prefix and target with eos suffix
test_collate_batch_metadata: test that Seq2SeqCollate returns correct ntokens, nsentences, and src_lengths metadata in the batch
